events.verdict: Potter (IND) is the last player to make contact with the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Black (ORL) is in Nesmith's (IND) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.
Mathurin (IND) firms up in a legal guarding position in front of Banchero (ORL) and absorbs the contact during his shot attempt.
Siakam (IND) is moving alongside Bane's (ORL) path as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Black (ORL) brings his left arm forward and the contact with Nembhard (IND) near midcourt is marginal.
Nesmith (IND) establishes himself in Black's (ORL) path prior to the contact.

Bane (ORL) moves laterally into Nembhard's (IND) path and initiates body contact that affects his SQBR. Nembhard stops and attempts the shot attempt outside of the LDB and since the illegal contact occurs prior to his upward shooting motion, a non-shooting foul is correctly assessed.
Suggs (ORL) and Potter (IND) come together at the same spot and the contact is marginal.
Nesmith (IND) puts his hand under the ball and brings it to a pause before resuming his dribble again.
Suggs (ORL) initiates body contact with Mathurin (IND) that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Nesmith (IND) initiates contact with Banchero's (ORL) arm during his driving shot attempt that is more than marginal.
Potter (IND) holds down Carter Jr.'s (ORL) arm and prevents him from pursuing the rebound.
Bane (ORL) legally contests Nesmith's (IND) jump shot attempt.
